rows.definition: Wall milliseconds per allocated lane-slot step (BatchWallMS/AllocatedSteps): what one batched slot actually cost. Heads the per-slot cost family - perSlot sizing and the ObservedPerSlotTokens probes measure how dear a slot is versus sequential tokens.
rows.distinction: Not SlotBytes (one slot's byte footprint) nor SlotFreed (the wire event releasing a slot): MSPerSlotStep is a TIME cost per step, not a size or a lifecycle event.
